name: agents-usage
description: Auto-records this machine's Codex CLI token usage into the agent platform's ledger (POST /api/v1/usage/sessions). Cumulative and idempotent: the hooks re-read the session rollout and send totals, so a hook that fires twice, or not at all, never mis-bills.

interface.shortDescription: Report this machine's token usage to an agent platform
interface.longDescription: Reports each Codex CLI session's token usage to an agent platform's usage ledger, so a subscription's quota spend is visible in one place whether an agent or a human spent it. Sends counts only — no prompts, answers, file names or tool names.
